collection.title: Fiat 124 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Fiat 124 Spider 2016 Onwards requires an 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
